source: USDA NASS 2022 Census of Agriculture, Volume 1, Chapter 2 (State Level Data), Table 10 'Irrigation: 2022 and 2017' — irrigated harvested cropland acres divided by total harvested cropland acres, rounded to two decimals (approximate; DC omitted). Used by feeds/usdm.ts: drought score × (1 − 0.8 × irrigatedShare), since irrigated acreage largely escapes the yield loss dryland acreage suffers at the same Drought Monitor class.
